headline: KickFlip's Keiju injures right thumb, JYP says
sub: He'll stay on all schedules but limit right-hand use
source: Source: Official notice from JYP Entertainment
caption:
KickFlip's Keiju has injured his right thumb, JYP Entertainment announced on Nov 25.

According to the agency, Keiju hurt his hand during dance practice and was diagnosed with a ligament injury. He will wear a brace and is expected to attend all upcoming schedules, but will keep right-hand use to a minimum, including at year-end broadcast and award show stages. Fan sign winners will be contacted separately about autographs. Wishing Keiju a speedy recovery!

📌 Source: Official notice from JYP Entertainment
